messages:
Mia (CSM): Quick check-in on Zenith — noticed hosted API spend jumping vs their monthly commit. Flagging here for triage.
Arjun (Account Lead): Thanks. Saw an automated alert at 10:15 UTC. Usage up 42% WoW, token burn concentrated on embeddings + long-gen routes.
zenith-billing-bot: [ALERT] Zenith Health (acct Z-8921) spend anomaly detected. 30m window: +48% vs expected. Forecast run rate > commit. Link: https://billing.redwood/alerts/Z-8921
Derek (SRE): Also seeing backend regressions around the same time. 5xx-rate rose from 0.2% -> 1.4% last 48h; p95 generation latency 120ms -> 320ms.
Nora (Finance): Commit is $12,000/mo. Current monthly burn = $9,100, 7-day run rate projects $14,200. If trend continues they'll breach commit mid-month.
Mia (CSM): Customer on a quick onboarding push — several new flows going live. They spun up parallel jobs calling `POST /v1/generate` with long contexts.
Arjun (Account Lead): Can we get per-route/top-call breakdown? Need to show Zenith where tokens are coming from for the enablement call.
Derek (SRE): Pushed a perf dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/zenith/telemetry — top ops: embeddings-heavy batches, KV-cache misses. Consider enabling prefix caching + smaller model variant.
Mia (CSM): Proposed mitigations: 1) soft rate limit on `api/v1/generate` for their org, 2) enable prefix caching for repeated prompts, 3) recommend `gpt-compat-q4_8bit` model for cost-sensitive paths.
Nora (Finance): Also propose alert thresholds for them: warn at 80% of commit, escalate at 100%.
zenith-billing-bot: [ACTION] Created alert policy 'Zenith-Commit-Thresholds' — notify: #customer-success + zenith-ops@zenith.com
Arjun (Account Lead): Mia, can you run the enablement session Thursday 16:00 PT? We'll present cost breakdown and rate-limit plan.
Mia (CSM): Yep. I'll prepare a short deck and sample queries showing cost per call. Also will capture their ask: they want clearer per-route spend and auto-scaling hints.
Derek (SRE): I'll try a config change: route-level soft cap + model fallback in the router. Test window tonight 22:00 UTC. If perf stabilizes, roll to prod.
Nora (Finance): For renewal health, mark as medium risk until we get run-rate under commit or adjust commit level.
Arjun (Account Lead): Agreed. I'll ping their PM and product lead to join the Thursday call.
Mia (CSM): Action items:
- Mia: prep cost breakdown + enablement (Thu 16:00 PT)
- Derek: test soft cap + fallback (22:00 UTC)
- Nora: update renewal risk and alert thresholds
- Arjun: coordinate customer invites
Mia (CSM): tagging @derek @nora for visibility :eyes:
Derek (SRE): :thumbsup: 
Arjun (Account Lead): Thanks team — will follow up with calendar invites and the pre-read.
zenith-billing-bot: [NOTE] Next billing snapshot scheduled: 1763884800
